title: Golden Retriever Dresses Up as a Ghost & Gives Mom the Halloween Scare of Her Life

content:
A strange noise in a dark hallway is enough to make anyone pause, especially when nobody else seems to be around. Ranger's mom is filming inside the house when she hears something clattering across the hardwood floor. She stops, looks toward the sound, and asks, "Did you hear that?" What she finds is a rather unexpected Halloween visitor: her Golden Retriever, sitting quietly in a ghost costume.

The clip shared by @thegoldenboyranger gets even funnier when the spooky figure seems to move closer between shots. Ranger may be ready for Halloween, but his mom clearly wasn't ready for him.

Golden Retriever's ghost costume for Halloween has everyone believe they're real

The video opens with Ranger's mom walking down a dim corridor, with the light from her phone illuminating her face. A sudden noise comes from somewhere ahead, sounding like something has fallen and bounced across the hardwood floor. She stops and looks toward it, looking genuinely startled.

Then the camera swings around, and there sits Ranger. His white ghost costume makes him look rather convincing from a distance, especially in the low light. The text on screen reads, "Terrifying ghost experience caught on camera," and his mom turns back to ask viewers, "Did you see that?"
She takes a few steps forward, turns the phone around again, and finds that the ghost is now much closer. Ranger hasn't exactly announced his arrival, either. He's just sitting there in costume, letting the whole spooky scene unfold.

His mom's caption says it all: "I'm so scared rn." The Halloween clip has received more than 1,700 likes, and viewers are happily playing along. One person joked, "I didn't know y'all had ghosts," while another said Ranger was "the only ghost we'd invite for cuddles.

A Golden Retriever in a ghost costume might not be the scariest thing to encounter at home, but Ranger certainly gave his mom a surprise she won't forget anytime soon.
